name: investor-day-video
description: AI Investor Day video: Remotion screen plates, overlays and animatic

scripts.render:plates: for c in S2-Underwrite S3-Brief S4-Rehab S6B-FollowUp S6A-DealBoard; do remotion render $c out/plates/$c.mp4 --crf=16 || exit 1; done
scripts.render:overlays: for c in O1-TimeAM O5-Offer O5-Offer-NoDollars O7-TimePM O7-CTA; do remotion render $c out/overlays/$c.mov --image-format=png --pixel-format=yuva444p10le --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 || exit 1; done
scripts.render:all: npm run render:animatic && npm run render:plates && npm run render:overlays
